graph.name: Datadog Kubernetes Scaling Architecture with Meta Cluster
graph.notes: Datadog uses a custom 'Meta Cluster' on EC2 to deploy and manage control planes for multiple individual Kubernetes clusters. Each Kubernetes cluster manages node groups backed by Auto Scaling Groups on EC2, load balanced via ELBs.
